  [Digital Health Media][192] Highly targeted brand awareness messaging in the EHR.*
* [Health Plans + Payers][193]
  [Health Plan Payers]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Health Plans + Payers overview][194]
  **Gap Closure**
  [Gap Closure Services][195] Proactive, clinically-driven services to help health plans and their
  network providers close care gaps.
  [Care Gap Alerting][196] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Provider Engagement Solutions][197] Streamlined payer-provider collaboration for better gap
  closure.
  **Risk Adjustment**
  [Health Equity Analytics][198] Go beyond Social Determinants of Health (SDoH).
  [Risk Adjustment Analytics][199] Analytics to find and prioritize gaps and opportunities.
  [Risk Mitigator][200] RADV audits - be prepared, not scared.
  [Comprehensive Submissions][201] One cloud-based data management platform for all government
  programs.
  [Utilization Analytics][202] Delivers visibility needed to monitor and manage key performance
  indicators.
  **Data Exchange + Coding**
  [eChart Courier][203] Automated electronic chart retrieval.
  [eChart Coder][204] Boost productivity and reduce costs with Veradigm eChart Coder.
  [eChart Integration and Analytics][205] Automated exchange of clinical data and medical record
  information for analysis.
  **Quality Management**
  [Quality Analytics][206] Proven analytic solution to help plans enhance Quality performance across
  their member base.
  [Risk Adjustment and Quality Management][207] Real-time visibility to monitor and manage your KPIs
  for risk and quality alike.
  **Clearinghouse + EDI**
  [Veradigm Payerpath][208] Claims and risk adjustment solution including an effective collaboration
  delivering streamlined EDI.
* [Healthcare Providers][209]
  [Healthcare Provider]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare Providers overview][210]
  **Our Platform**
  [Veradigm Suite][211] Explore Veradigm’s powerful healthcare solutions designed to streamline
  operations, improve patient care, and boost practice efficiency.
  **Streamline Practice Operations**
  [Practice Management][212] Simplified software for effortless scheduling, billing, and claims
  processing.
  [AI Patient Scheduling][213] Automate and optimize patient scheduling with artificial
  intelligence.
  **Improve Clinical Efficiency**
  [EHR Software][214] Adaptable ambulatory EHR platform that supports your clinical documentation
  and workflow needs.
  [ePrescribe][215] Affordable and certified e-Prescribing solution including controlled substances.
  [Gap Closure Alerting][216] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Clinical Data Registries][217] Registry participation for providers.
  [eChart Courier][218] Save time, reduce costs, and increase efficiency by automating medical chart
  retrieval.
  **Maximize Revenue**
  [Revenue Cycle Services][219] Let us handle billing, minimize denials, enhance coding, and ensure
  timely payments.
  [Coding Services][220] Get help to reduce staff burden and increase revenue - let our team manage
  coding for you.
  [Veradigm Payerpath][221] All-in-one revenue cycle management solution that features a top-tier
  clearinghouse.
  [Veradigm Intelligent Payments][222] Simplify patient billing and boost collections with
  intelligent, automated payments.
  **Engage Patients**
  [Patient Engagement Platform][223] Integrate with a mobile-first patient engagement platform.
  **Optimize Resources and Spend**
  [ERP Fiscal Management][224] Automate finance workflows and improve visibility into spend,
  reporting, and compliance.
  [ERP Point of Use][225] Track supply usage in clinical settings to reduce waste and improve
  accuracy.
  [ERP Supply Chain][226] Streamline purchasing and inventory with real-time visibility from
  requisition to delivery.
* [Health IT Vendors][227]
  [Veradigm Network]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare IT Vendor Solutions overview][228]
  **Powered by the Network**
  [Life Sciences][229] Empowering life science with trusted data and insights from the point of
  care.
  [Health Plans + Payers][230] Connecting payers to the Veradigm Network’s comprehensive, national
  provider footprint.
  [Providers][231] Integrated clinical & financial solutions for a healthier practice.
  **API Connectivity**
  [Veradigm Connect][232] Connect the latest health tech solutions with the physicians and patients
  who need them.
  [App Expo][233] Become one of hundreds of certified applications and devices for provider
  practices built on open APIs.
  [Diagnostic Ordering and Results Network (DORN)][234] Connecting EHR Vendors with Lab and
  Radiology centers.
  **Electronic Prescribing**
  [Veradigm ePrescribe Enterprise][235] Integrated, advanced, easy-to-use ePrescribing for EHR and
  HIT vendors.

  [RWE Publications][243] Read through our RWE publications and learn how we help clients.
  [Clinical Data Registries][244] Explore our registry publications and learn how we help clients.

  blog articles, white papers and more.

[Patient at the Heart]

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

[
Explore more on
[EpicShare]
][7]
[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

[Patient at the Heart]

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

[
Explore more on
[EpicShare]
][7]
[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

  **AI Data Catalog**
  
  Unifies all your private structured and unstructured data without moving it – by using the AI Data
  Platform's Data Catalog
  
  [Get started with AI Data Catalog][24]
  
  **AI Data Platform Workbench**
  
  An end-to-end Integrated Development Environment for building any type of AI Application – chat,
  multistep agents, transactions, workflows – on all your data
  
  [Get started with AI Data Platform Workbench][25]
  
  [Learn More][26]
  [AI Data Platform with Multimodal AI models, Public Data and Private Data Lakehouse]
  
  ### AI models reason on private data
  
  All private data unified in data catalog
* [Cloud@Customer]
  
  ### All OCI Services in 3 Racks
  
  Installed in your data center from $250,000 per month
  
  ## Cloud@Customer
  
  **All OCI Services and Applications**
  
  Put the entire Oracle Cloud inside your data center. Cloud@Customer includes every Oracle
  infrastructure service and application. Your data and network traffic stay secure and private
  inside your data center and behind your firewall.
  
  **Enable AI on your Private Data**
  
  Now you can do AI inferencing and multistep reasoning on your private data while keeping that data
  private.
  
  [Learn more][27]
* ## Fusion Applications
  
  Fusion is the only application suite that brings AI to every aspect of your business:
  
  **ERP Applications**
  
  [Finance and Accounting][28]
  [Supply Chain and Manufacturing][29]
  
  **HCM Applications**
  
  [Human Resources][30]
  [Payroll][31]
  
  **Customer Experience**
  
  [Marketing][32]
  [Sales][33]
  [Service][34]
  
  [Learn more][35]
  [Fusion Application Suite]
  
  ### DHL Supply Chain runs on Oracle Fusion
  
  Modernizes back-office operations and enables innovation
* [Health Application Suite]
  
  ### Digital Ambulance
  
  Patients are continually monitored in transit by hospital ER doctors
  
  ## Health Application Suite
  
  Oracle Health is the first of our Application Suites to be entirely rebuilt as a set of AI Agents
  connected by workflows. The Oracle Health Suite includes applications for managing the entire
  healthcare ecosystem including providers: ambulatory clinics, acute care
  hospitals; payers: insurance companies, governments;  and public health and regulatory agencies.
  
  **Healthcare Applications**
  
  Ambulatory Care System for Clinics
  Acute Care System for Hospitals
  Clinical and Financial Operations
  Payer Preauthorization System
  
  **Healthcare Technology Foundation**
  
  Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
  AI Data Platform
  Oracle AI Database
  
  [Learn more][36]
* ## Industry Specific Applications
  
  Oracle provides industry specific cloud application suites for more than two dozen industries.
  These are modern SaaS applications with built-in AI, machine learning, and analytics. These
  industry applications integrate seamlessly with core business functions in Fusion ERP, HCM, Supply
  Chain, Finance, and Customer Experience. Here are a few examples:
  
  **Banking Suite**
  
  Includes core banking, anti-money laundering, risk management, compliance, and AI analytics.
  
  **Construction and Engineering**
  
  Includes project management, procurement, supplier analytics, subcontractor payments, cost
  controls, and more.
  
  **Retail Suite**
  
  Includes merchandising, multistore inventory management, omnichannel demand forecasting, etc.

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

[Explore Building X][7]

plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

## One digital twin, clear operational insight

At the University of Wollongong, a digital twin brings together data from 1,000 assets, 500 BMS
points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

[Explore Building X][7]
[Amazonia rainforest]

## A digital twin in the Amazon rainforest

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

[Read the story][8]
[A person wearing a headset interacts with a holographic display of 3D models and data
visualizations.]

register now.

[Register now][9]

intelligence, simulation and smart technologies, moving you from digital blueprint to real-world
impact.

solicitud gratis y recibe presupuestos de expertos.

Urgencia: Alta

### El Aire Acondicionado No Enfría

El equipo funciona pero no enfría o enfría poco
* Falta de gas refrigerante por fuga
* Filtros sucios obstruyendo el flujo
* Compresor dañado o en mal estado
* Sensor de temperatura descalibrado

Urgencia: Media

### Goteo o Fugas de Agua

El split pierde agua por el interior o exterior
* Desagüe obstruido o mal instalado
* Fuga en el circuito de condensación
* Bandeja de drenaje agrietada
* Bomba de condensados averiada

Urgencia: Media

### Ruidos Extraños o Vibración

El equipo hace ruidos anormales al funcionar
* Rodamientos del ventilador desgastados
* Compresor con problemas mecánicos
* Soportes de instalación flojos
* Objetos extraños en el ventilador

Urgencia: Alta

### El Equipo No Enciende

El aire acondicionado no arranca o se apaga solo
* Problemas en la tarjeta electrónica
* Termostato defectuoso
* Fallo en el sistema eléctrico
* Fusibles o magnetotérmicos quemados

Urgencia: Baja

### Consumo Eléctrico Elevado

La factura de luz aumenta significativamente
* Filtros obstruidos reduciendo eficiencia
* Nivel de gas refrigerante bajo
* Equipo sobredimensionado o subdimensionado
* Falta de mantenimiento preventivo

Urgencia: Media

### Mal Olor al Encender

Sale olor desagradable del aire acondicionado
* Hongos y bacterias en el evaporador
* Filtros sucios sin limpiar
* Agua estancada en la bandeja
* Necesidad de limpieza profunda

### ¿Qué incluye el servicio de reparación de aire acondicionado?

Un servicio completo de reparación en ClimaJobs incluye:
* **Diagnóstico completo** del problema con herramientas profesionales
* **Reparación**: fugas, recarga de gas refrigerante R32/R410A, componentes eléctricos
* **Limpieza** de filtros y unidades interior/exterior
* **Pruebas de funcionamiento** y revisión de conexiones eléctricas
* **Garantía del trabajo** realizado con precios acordados antes de empezar

## ¿Necesitas un técnico de aire acondicionado en Barcelona?

Publica tu avería gratis y recibe presupuestos de técnicos profesionales de tu zona.

Comenzar ahora gratis

Sin compromisos • Registro en 2 minutos

## Servicios de Reparación de Aire Acondicionado en Barcelona

En ClimaJobs conectamos clientes con técnicos especializados en todo tipo de servicios de aire
acondicionado. Encuentra profesionales para cualquier necesidad de climatización en Barcelona.

### Encuentra Técnicos para Reparación de Fugas de Gas

Conecta con especialistas en detección y reparación de fugas en sistemas R32, R410A y R22. Técnicos
con equipos de última generación para localizar y sellar fugas de gas refrigerante.

### Especialistas en Compresores y Condensadores

Encuentra técnicos especializados en diagnóstico y reparación de compresores. Profesionales que
reparan o sustituyen compresores, condensadores y evaporadores de todas las marcas.

### Técnicos en Problemas Eléctricos de AC

Conecta con especialistas en fallos eléctricos, tarjetas electrónicas, sensores y termostatos.
Técnicos con experiencia en diagnóstico eléctrico de sistemas de climatización.

### Profesionales en Mantenimiento Preventivo

Encuentra técnicos para limpieza profunda de filtros, evaporadores y drenaje. Especialistas en
mantenimiento preventivo completo con revisión de gas, presión y desinfección.

### Especialistas en Carga de Gas Refrigerante

Conecta con técnicos especializados en carga de gas R32, R410A y R22 con equipos calibrados.
Profesionales en optimización del rendimiento energético de sistemas de climatización.

### Técnicos Especializados en Instalación

Encuentra instaladores profesionales de equipos Split, Multi-Split y conductos. Técnicos que
realizan revisiones de seguridad con informe técnico completo.

### Encuentra el Técnico Perfecto para tu Necesidad

ClimaJobs es la **plataforma que conecta clientes con técnicos profesionales de aire acondicionado
en Barcelona**. En nuestra red encontrarás especialistas con años de experiencia en todas las
**marcas de aire acondicionado** (Daikin, Mitsubishi, LG, Samsung, Fujitsu, Toshiba, Panasonic) y
tipos de refrigerante (R32, R410A, R22). Publica tu solicitud **gratis**, recibe múltiples
**presupuestos de técnicos profesionales** y elige al que mejor se adapte a tus necesidades. Ya sea
que necesites una **reparación urgente**, **mantenimiento preventivo** o **instalación de equipo
nuevo**, encontrarás el técnico ideal en ClimaJobs.

## Encuentra Técnicos Especializados para Cada Problema

¿Tu aire acondicionado no funciona correctamente? Estos son los problemas más frecuentes. Identifica
tu problema y conecta con técnicos especializados en Barcelona que pueden solucionarlo. Publica tu
solicitud gratis y recibe presupuestos de expertos.

Urgencia: Alta

### El Aire Acondicionado No Enfría

El equipo funciona pero no enfría o enfría poco
* Falta de gas refrigerante por fuga
* Filtros sucios obstruyendo el flujo
* Compresor dañado o en mal estado
* Sensor de temperatura descalibrado

Urgencia: Media

### Goteo o Fugas de Agua

El split pierde agua por el interior o exterior
* Desagüe obstruido o mal instalado
* Fuga en el circuito de condensación
* Bandeja de drenaje agrietada
* Bomba de condensados averiada

Urgencia: Media

### Ruidos Extraños o Vibración

El equipo hace ruidos anormales al funcionar
* Rodamientos del ventilador desgastados
* Compresor con problemas mecánicos
* Soportes de instalación flojos
* Objetos extraños en el ventilador

Urgencia: Alta

### El Equipo No Enciende

El aire acondicionado no arranca o se apaga solo
* Problemas en la tarjeta electrónica
* Termostato defectuoso
* Fallo en el sistema eléctrico
* Fusibles o magnetotérmicos quemados

Urgencia: Baja

### Consumo Eléctrico Elevado

La factura de luz aumenta significativamente
* Filtros obstruidos reduciendo eficiencia
* Nivel de gas refrigerante bajo
* Equipo sobredimensionado o subdimensionado
* Falta de mantenimiento preventivo

Urgencia: Media

### Mal Olor al Encender

Sale olor desagradable del aire acondicionado
* Hongos y bacterias en el evaporador
* Filtros sucios sin limpiar
* Agua estancada en la bandeja
* Necesidad de limpieza profunda

gratis**, describe los síntomas y recibe **múltiples presupuestos de técnicos profesionales** en
Barcelona. Nuestra plataforma conecta con especialistas en todas las marcas y modelos. Compara
ofertas, revisa valoraciones y elige al técnico que mejor se adapte a tu necesidad y presupuesto.

### Products
### 

[Multicolumn Image]

Equip your laboratory for peak performance with Copan's unmatched, expertly engineered sample
collection and transport devices and laboratory essentials.

[ Explore Products ][62]

### Laboratory Automation & AI

[Multicolumn Image]

Unlock new levels of efficiency with Copan's transformative automation and AI innovations.
Experience how our customized solutions support your team so you can focus on what matters most.

[ Learn More ][63]

### Scientific Studies
### 

[a]

Explore our full library of scientific studies documenting the proven performance of our innovative
collection devices, automation, and AI across diverse applications and workflows.

[ Find Studies ][64]

## Innovation is in Our DNA

Since 1979, Copan has combined innovation with a forward-looking vision for the laboratory,
developing early automation concepts and inventing flocked swab technology, now a global standard in
specimen collection.

 

Today, we continue to innovate with solutions that strengthen every step of the laboratory workflow,
from specimen collection and transport to processing and interpretation, integrating automation and
AI to improve efficiency and consistency.

 

Working in close collaboration with the microbiology community, we solve real laboratory challenges
so laboratories can deliver reliable results and support better patient care.

## FDA-Cleared Innovation

PhenoMATRIX^{®}, Copan’s AI-powered image assessment software for WASPLab^{®} automation, is now FDA
510(k) cleared in the United States.
By automatically sorting culture plate images using artificial intelligence and laboratory-defined
rules, PhenoMATRIX helps laboratories streamline plate review, improve efficiency, and maintain
expert control.

## Applying the power of science and technology

## to deliver innovation

## at the speed of life.

We’re Danaher - a leading global life sciences and diagnostics innovator, committed to accelerating
the power of science and technology to improve human health.

[A microscopic image of a cell]
[A male doctor talks with a patient in a meeting room]
[Zoomed in image of a petri dish]
Our businesses
Biotechnology
[A microscopic image of a cell]

Advancements in healthcare and medicine are moving at an unprecedented pace with a promising
pipeline of innovative drugs on the horizon that are more targeted, personalized, and effective than
ever before. Our biotechnology business brings expertise, technologies, and services that accelerate
the development and commercialization of these life-changing therapies, ensuring that they can be
delivered quickly and safely to the patients who need them.

[Learn about biotechnology][66]
Diagnostics
[A male doctor talks with a patient in a meeting room]

There is an urgent need for better, more expansive health care—and we’re ready to meet it. Our
diagnostics businesses create tools and software designed to improve confidence in precise and rapid
diagnoses.

[Learn about diagnostics ][67]
Life Sciences
[Zoomed in image of a petri dish]

In a world that’s ever-changing, our customers work to advance innovations that improve human
health. Our life sciences businesses power tools and technologies that support our customers in a
wide range of critical activities, whether it’s creating breakthrough cell and gene therapies,
ensuring high-quality fluid filtration in labs, or driving the latest advances in molecular
oncology.           

[Learn about life sciences][68]

This is how Danaher brings innovation at the speed of life to the world—by connecting science,
accelerating progress, and delivering impact at global scale.

Danaher Business System

#### Act. Improve. Repeat.

Success at Danaher doesn't happen by accident. We have a proven system for achieving it called the
Danaher Business System (DBS). DBS guides every aspect of our culture and performance. It’s how we
consistently turn ideas into impact—helping our businesses move faster, collaborate more
effectively, and deliver results with quality and certainty at scale.

[See the DBS impact][69]
[Acceleration, momentum pattern]

### Bringing new possibilities to life

Our collaborative approach means we solve the hardest problems—together—with customers and partners
around the world.

#### Innovative mindset

Curiosity and continuous improvement are at Danaher’s core. We want to learn more, find new
solutions, and deliver better results. 

[See how we work][70]

#### Initiatives

We’re determined to break down silos and unite bright minds across academia and industry. Our
partnership initiatives are designed to do just that.

[See current initiatives][71]

#### Acquisitions

From adding exciting new technologies to contributing new perspectives and skills to our extended
team, our focused acquisition strategy is essential as we accelerate the power of science and
technology to help our customers, our companies and our shareholders.

[Learn about acquisitions][72]

## Applying the power of science and technology

## to deliver innovation

## at the speed of life.

We’re Danaher - a leading global life sciences and diagnostics innovator, committed to accelerating
the power of science and technology to improve human health.

[A microscopic image of a cell]
[A male doctor talks with a patient in a meeting room]
[Zoomed in image of a petri dish]
Our businesses
Biotechnology
[A microscopic image of a cell]

Advancements in healthcare and medicine are moving at an unprecedented pace with a promising
pipeline of innovative drugs on the horizon that are more targeted, personalized, and effective than
ever before. Our biotechnology business brings expertise, technologies, and services that accelerate
the development and commercialization of these life-changing therapies, ensuring that they can be
delivered quickly and safely to the patients who need them.

[Learn about biotechnology][66]
Diagnostics
[A male doctor talks with a patient in a meeting room]

There is an urgent need for better, more expansive health care—and we’re ready to meet it. Our
diagnostics businesses create tools and software designed to improve confidence in precise and rapid
diagnoses.

[Learn about diagnostics ][67]
Life Sciences
[Zoomed in image of a petri dish]

In a world that’s ever-changing, our customers work to advance innovations that improve human
health. Our life sciences businesses power tools and technologies that support our customers in a
wide range of critical activities, whether it’s creating breakthrough cell and gene therapies,
ensuring high-quality fluid filtration in labs, or driving the latest advances in molecular
oncology.           

[Learn about life sciences][68]

This is how Danaher brings innovation at the speed of life to the world—by connecting science,
accelerating progress, and delivering impact at global scale.

Danaher Business System

#### Act. Improve. Repeat.

Success at Danaher doesn't happen by accident. We have a proven system for achieving it called the
Danaher Business System (DBS). DBS guides every aspect of our culture and performance. It’s how we
consistently turn ideas into impact—helping our businesses move faster, collaborate more
effectively, and deliver results with quality and certainty at scale.

[See the DBS impact][69]
[Acceleration, momentum pattern]

### Bringing new possibilities to life

Our collaborative approach means we solve the hardest problems—together—with customers and partners
around the world.

#### Innovative mindset

Curiosity and continuous improvement are at Danaher’s core. We want to learn more, find new
solutions, and deliver better results. 

[See how we work][70]

#### Initiatives

We’re determined to break down silos and unite bright minds across academia and industry. Our
partnership initiatives are designed to do just that.

[See current initiatives][71]

From adding exciting new technologies to contributing new perspectives and skills to our extended

technology to help our customers, our companies and our shareholders.

# Hard Problems,
# Proven Models

Some problems need more than an API call. Pricing engines that underwrite billions. Computer vision
that earns FDA approval. Predictive systems that win championships. Dr. Erik Allen and team have
been solving these for over 20 years — and shipping them into production.

[Start a Project][12][Learn More][13]
[
[Erik Allen, Ph.D.]

Practice Lead

### Erik Allen, Ph.D.

Erik Allen holds a Ph.D. in Computational Simulation from MIT. He built the predictive models that
became the largest betting operation in Major League Baseball during the 2004–05 season, and
designed the real-time decision-making systems that helped NASCAR race teams win three national
championships before the technology was acquired by General Motors in 2020. He has led teams of 50+
technical staff, mentored and built at over 20 startups, and most recently architected the core
underwriting model for Pie Insurance, now writing over $500M in annual premium and powering a
billion-dollar business.

][14]

## Case Studies

A selection of projects where we’ve partnered with companies to solve their hardest problems.

[NASCAR]

### Real-time race strategy that wins championships

Predictive ModelsDecision Science

Designed decision-making software used by pit crews during live races. Contributed to three NASCAR
national championships. Technology acquired by General Motors (NYSE: GM) in 2020.

[Allianz]

### Automating insurance claims with specialized AI agents

Agentic AIClaims Automation

Worked with Allianz Group Technology to build Project Nemo, their first agentic AI system for
automating insurance claims. Reduced claims processing time by 80%, settling simple claims in
minutes instead of days. Built and deployed in under 100 days.

[Imidex]

### Detecting cancer with superhuman accuracy

Computer Vision

Built a computer vision model for lung cancer detection that surpassed FDA medical device standards,
leading to 510(k) FDA approval for Imidex's VisiRad XR product.

[Read case study][15]
[BBHedge]

### Where algorithmic sports betting started

Predictive ModelsDecision Science

A team of MIT PhDs built statistically rigorous predictive models for baseball betting, years before
analytics-driven wagering existed. The models returned 33,000% in a single season on a small
bankroll. The team later collaborated with Billy Beane, the Oakland A's GM behind the Moneyball
story.

[Pie Insurance]

### Pricing Workers' Comp at a billion-dollar scale

Predictive ModelsPricing

Architected the core loss ratio underwriting model for Workers' Comp, one of the hardest lines in
insurance to price. The model now underwrites over $500M in annual premium and is the foundation of
a billion-dollar business.

[Rubicon]

### Computer vision on every garbage truck in America

Computer Vision

Built convolutional neural networks that detect and count waste containers on truck routes in real
time, turning a previously opaque fleet operation into a computable problem. The models enabled
remote monitoring of truck assets at national scale and became the foundation of Rubicon's Fleet
Technology Business Unit. Sold for ~$100M in 2024.

[Rubicon]

### Pricing every ZIP Code in America, instantly

Predictive ModelsPricing

Built a nationwide pricing engine that cut average quote time from over a day to under a minute,
unlocking the growth trajectory that led to Rubicon's IPO.

[OpenWorks]

### Sub-second pricing for a national custodial services franchise

Data WarehousePricing

Built the core data warehouse that unified OpenWorks's disparate data sources, then designed
automated pricing models on top of it that brought pricing decisions down to sub-second response
times across multiple systems.

[FlashParking]

### Identifying every vehicle in every parking lot

Computer VisionUnique Entity Resolution

Built convolutional neural networks for automatic vehicle recognition at parking facility entry and
exit points. Replaced the need for attendants or mechanical gate systems with a single camera feed
handling identification and access control. Enabled FlashParking to scale to over 16,000 locations
across North America.

[Lineup.ai]

### Real-time demand forecasting that actually works

Predictive Models

Combined sales data with weather, events, holidays, and TV schedules to improve demand prediction
accuracy by 40%, directly reducing labor costs and waste across locations.

[IDI Logistics]

### Automating government data workflows with AI

Generative AIAdvanced Web Scraping

Built a system that scrapes 100+ government websites and delivers weekly AI-generated intelligence
summaries, replacing days of manual research with a single automated pipeline.

[Read case study][16]

Ready to start?

are wanting to expand your existing AI suite, we are here to help.

We will discuss with you where you are, where you want to be, and how we can achieve it with AI -
whether by a bespoke solution or using one of our off-the-shelf products

### AI Data Analysis & Preparation

We will work with you to gather, analyse and prepare all your relevant data sources for use in the
AI system(s)

### AI Execute & Visualisation

We will run and tune the AI throughout the AI learning process and enable the AI to produce a real
time visual output to confirm the AI is producing beneficial results

### AI Integration

When you are satisfied the AI is delivering the results you desire, we will integrate the AI with
your new or existing systems

Fennaio works with all industries to integrate artificial intelligence with numerous new and
existing operations, systems and software

[Learn more][91]

[Fennaio Integrated Artificial Intelligence Software]

# AI software, systems & solutions

Fennaio produces a range of artificial intelligence & machine learning tools for all business needs

[Learn more][92]

[Fennaio Integrated Artificial Intelligence Consultants]

# Your complete AI partner

Fennaio is a team of skilled and experienced AI consultants and engineers who can help you at every
stage of your AI implementation journey

[Learn more][93]

## What is AI, exactly?

You've heard of AI, Machine Learning & Data Science but you're not exactly sure what they are,
whether they're of benefit to you, where you can use them or how you can use the technology. Click
below for a quick guide to get started on your AI journey.

[Get started with AI »][96]

## AI Software & Systems

You've decided you want to embrace the technological revolution that is Artificial Intelligence and
you would now like some AI software for your organisation. Click below to see our comprehensive
range of turnkey AI software and systems.

[AI Software & Systems»][97]

## AI Services & Consultancy

You have an Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning or Data Science goal in mind,
but you need a trusted partner to help you along the full AI journey to make your ideas become a
reality. Click below to see our full AI consultancy services.

[AI Consultancy »][98]

## AI Industries & Market Sectors

You're interested to know if your industry, market sector, business or process type is using AI, and
how they're doing it; or you're curious to know if we can provide Artificial Intelligence services
to your specific operations. Click below to see all the industries we work with.

[AI Industries »][99]

## The future *is* Artificial Intelligence. Fennaio can make it happen for you.

From AI Consultancy to AI Software & Systems to AI Research, Fennaio provides the expertise and
entire AI package enabling you to embrace and integrate AI in whatever industry you operate in.

[See our AI Software & Systems»][100]

[Fennaio AI Software and Systems]

## Research-led AI solutions. Fennaio is always on top.

Fennaio creates world class software, systems and solutions for all industries due to our
research-led approach. Our creative and driven team make sure we're using the best tech and
approaches available.

[See our AI Labs»][101]

[Fennaio AI Research]

## Your trusted AI partner. Fennaio makes AI achievable for all.

Fennaio works closely with you at all stages of AI implementation. We strive to form long lasting,
transparent relationships with all our clients and make AI easily accessible to everyone.

[See our AI Consultancy Services »][102]

[Fennaio AI Consultants]

## How Fennaio works with you at every stage of the AI and ML Integration process.

Whether you are starting out on your first AI project, just interested in the possibilities of AI or
are wanting to expand your existing AI suite, we are here to help.

### AI Survey & Plan

We will discuss with you where you are, where you want to be, and how we can achieve it with AI -
whether by a bespoke solution or using one of our off-the-shelf products

### AI Data Analysis & Preparation

We will work with you to gather, analyse and prepare all your relevant data sources for use in the
AI system(s)

### AI Execute & Visualisation

We will run and tune the AI throughout the AI learning process and enable the AI to produce a real
time visual output to confirm the AI is producing beneficial results

### AI Integration

When you are satisfied the AI is delivering the results you desire, we will integrate the AI with
your new or existing systems

## You are one step closer to getting Artificial Intelligence into your organisation

Fennaio has the expertise to get you up and running with AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning and
Data Science in your new or existing systems, software and operations.

## Miles de médicos usan Invox Medical en su día a día

“Es como tener un asistente que va transcribiendo lo que va pasando en la consulta. Nosotros podemos
estar mirando al paciente, interpretando sus gestos y no tenemos que estar escribiendo. El programa
lo hace todo. "
Dr. Miguel Pérez Ferrer
Doctor en Aparato Digestivo en Viamed Montecanal
"El dictado por voz es muy recomendable para confeccionar los informes clínicos, porque ahorra
tiempo al profesional y mejora la calidad de los informes."
Dr. Ismael Said Criado
Internista en el Servicio Gallego de Salud
"Ahora puedo hacer el informe en tiempo real mientras realizo el procedimiento endoscópico,
mejorando la calidad de la información."
Dr. Álvaro Martínez-Alcala
Médico especialista en Aparato Digestivo en Hospital Universitario Infanta Leonor
"Antes, en una consulta de psiquiatría podía dedicar hasta 15 o 20 minutos a documentar los
epígrafes necesarios. Ahora, el informe puede estar listo en 20 segundos. El nivel de
personalización de la herramienta es muy grande y la satisfacción con Invox Genesis está siendo muy
alta."
Dr. Francisco Montañés
Jefe del Servicio de Psiquiatría del Hospital Universitario Fundación de Alcorcón
"O INVOX Medical é, realmente, uma ferramenta útil econfiável para a transcrição de relatórios."
Dr. Omar Abou Ezzeddine
Gerente Medico - Pinheiros Diagnósticos por Imagem
“La ventaja es que ahora uno puede interactuar con el paciente sin necesidad de mirar el monitor y
la misma inteligencia artificial se encarga de transcribir la historia clínica de una forma óptima.”
Dr. David Serra Kasem
Médico de Urgencias en Viamed Los Manzanos
"La fiabilidad que alcanza el reconocimiento es muy elevada. También resaltaría la capacidad de
poder dictar tanto en el propio RIS como en la ventana de dictado o en cualquier documento de
texto."
Dr. José Carmelo Albillos Merino
Jefe de Servicio de Radiodiagnóstico en la UCR
"Es una herramienta muy útil y que no solo ayuda, si no que da otros beneficios tanto en el ahorro
de tiempo como el ahorro de costes."
Dr. Félix Manzarbeitia Arambarri
Jefe de Servicio de Anatomía

## Preguntas frecuentes

¿En qué países tiene representación Invox Medical?

Contamos con un amplio equipo comercial y técnico en España, Portugal y toda América del Sur,
incluida Brasil.

¿Con qué sistemas es compatible Invox Medical?

Nuestros sistemas se adaptan a tu entorno tecnológico y puede interactuar o integrarse con tus
actuales herramientas, así como desplegarse tanto en servidor local como en la nube.

¿Por qué las soluciones de Invox Medical son más precisas que otros sistemas?

En primer lugar, disponemos de un sistema de reconocimiento de voz propio y modelos lingüísticos
específicos para cada especialidad médica, entrenados para entender mejor la terminología propia del
sector de la salud. Por otro lado, cuando implementamos nuestras soluciones en una organización
sanitaria, trabajamos junto a los clínicos para configurar y personalizar la herramienta a los
requerimientos de información que tienen que registrar según el servicio o la tipología de caso
clínico.

¿En qué idiomas está disponible Invox Medical?

Nuestras soluciones están disponibles en español, portugués, portugués de Brasil, catalán, euskera y
gallego y entienden cualquier acento dentro de estos idiomas.

¿En qué dispositivos se puede usar Invox Medical?

Nuestras soluciones se pueden usar en cualquier dispositivo móvil, tablet u ordenador.

## ¿Quieres más información? Contacta con nuestro equipo

Si quieres una demostración, recibir asesoramiento personalizado o resolver todas tus dudas y
consultas, contacta con nuestro equipo.

## Preguntas frecuentes

¿En qué países tiene representación Invox Medical?

Contamos con un amplio equipo comercial y técnico en España, Portugal y toda América del Sur,
incluida Brasil.

¿Con qué sistemas es compatible Invox Medical?

Nuestros sistemas se adaptan a tu entorno tecnológico y puede interactuar o integrarse con tus
actuales herramientas, así como desplegarse tanto en servidor local como en la nube.

¿Por qué las soluciones de Invox Medical son más precisas que otros sistemas?

En primer lugar, disponemos de un sistema de reconocimiento de voz propio y modelos lingüísticos
específicos para cada especialidad médica, entrenados para entender mejor la terminología propia del
sector de la salud. Por otro lado, cuando implementamos nuestras soluciones en una organización
sanitaria, trabajamos junto a los clínicos para configurar y personalizar la herramienta a los
requerimientos de información que tienen que registrar según el servicio o la tipología de caso
clínico.

¿En qué idiomas está disponible Invox Medical?

Nuestras soluciones están disponibles en español, portugués, portugués de Brasil, catalán, euskera y
gallego y entienden cualquier acento dentro de estos idiomas.

¿En qué dispositivos se puede usar Invox Medical?

Nuestras soluciones se pueden usar en cualquier dispositivo móvil, tablet u ordenador.

# HIT DISCOVERY AT SCALE FOR UNDRUGGABLE TARGETS

Sapian is a universal AI-driven **small molecule** discovery engine which overcomes "undruggable"
barriers facing structure-based approaches thanks to novel AI models powered by hundreds of millions
of datapoints.

The result: **IP-clean chemistry** for the most challenging therapeutic targets, selected amongst 13
billion possible candidates.

[ UNDERSTAND SAPIAN ][12]

# UNLOCKING STALLED DISCOVERY

Built for hard cases

Sapian excels even in areas where traditional data-hungry AI fails. Even for targets with no 3D
structure or no known modulator, Sapian finds the needle in the haystack.

Reopening closed doors

Sapian is validated in different categories of targets: ion channels, antigens, ubiquitin-line
proteins, as supported by experimental data from a series of independent labs.

Exploring untapped space

Sapian routinely screens 13 billion compounds in less than a day. This represents a 10 000-fold
increase compared to the average screening campaign in pharma.

[Kantify team]

Behind Sapian is a team with a mission at heart: improve human health with AI.

A personal story of one of our founding members led us to reinvent some of the core principles of
how AI is used in drug discovery and become pioneers in the post-docking era.

# A ROSETTA STONE FOR DRUG DISCOVERY

Find drugs faster, repeatably

Sapian can identify effective modulators for any biological target. While results vary with target
complexity, no target has yet been left undrugged by Sapian. **Several first-in-class molecules**
have already been discovered by Sapian.

Explore untapped chemical space

Sapian enables systematic exploration of **vast, previously inaccessible chemical space.** By
revealing the potential of underexplored molecules, Sapian helps identify high-value candidates with
clear rationale and strong predictive confidence.

Select drugs with less hidden risks

One of Sapian's key capabilities is to predict the pharmacodynamic and pharmacokinetic profile of
drugs, **across the entire eukaryotic proteome, a unique capability.** In doing so, Sapian can
pro-actively select the most selective drugs in silico.

Decide with predictability

Sapian was built with the obsession to bring predictability and risk mitigation to the complexity of
drug discovery. Sapian augments drug discovery, enabling to identify the best drug candidates with
**clear safety filters, high IP potential, and high predictability.**

# HIT DISCOVERY AT SCALE FOR UNDRUGGABLE TARGETS

Sapian is a universal AI-driven **small molecule** discovery engine which overcomes "undruggable"
barriers facing structure-based approaches thanks to novel AI models powered by hundreds of millions
of datapoints.

The result: **IP-clean chemistry** for the most challenging therapeutic targets, selected amongst 13
billion possible candidates.

[ UNDERSTAND SAPIAN ][12]

# UNLOCKING STALLED DISCOVERY

Built for hard cases

Sapian excels even in areas where traditional data-hungry AI fails. Even for targets with no 3D
structure or no known modulator, Sapian finds the needle in the haystack.

Reopening closed doors

Sapian is validated in different categories of targets: ion channels, antigens, ubiquitin-line
proteins, as supported by experimental data from a series of independent labs.

Exploring untapped space

Sapian routinely screens 13 billion compounds in less than a day. This represents a 10 000-fold
increase compared to the average screening campaign in pharma.

[Kantify team]

Behind Sapian is a team with a mission at heart: improve human health with AI.

A personal story of one of our founding members led us to reinvent some of the core principles of
how AI is used in drug discovery and become pioneers in the post-docking era.

# A ROSETTA STONE FOR DRUG DISCOVERY

Find drugs faster, repeatably

Sapian can identify effective modulators for any biological target. While results vary with target
complexity, no target has yet been left undrugged by Sapian. **Several first-in-class molecules**
have already been discovered by Sapian.

Explore untapped chemical space

Sapian enables systematic exploration of **vast, previously inaccessible chemical space.** By
revealing the potential of underexplored molecules, Sapian helps identify high-value candidates with
clear rationale and strong predictive confidence.

Select drugs with less hidden risks

One of Sapian's key capabilities is to predict the pharmacodynamic and pharmacokinetic profile of
drugs, **across the entire eukaryotic proteome, a unique capability.** In doing so, Sapian can
pro-actively select the most selective drugs in silico.

Decide with predictability

Sapian was built with the obsession to bring predictability and risk mitigation to the complexity of
drug discovery. Sapian augments drug discovery, enabling to identify the best drug candidates with
**clear safety filters, high IP potential, and high predictability.**

## What Can We Offer

##### [Coold Rooms][158]

Storage cold rooms or positive temperature cold rooms, are designed for the conservation of products
between -5 and +5 ºC.

[READ MORE][159]

##### [Freezer Rooms][160]

Freezing cold rooms or negative temperature cold rooms are used to keep frozen products
between -18 and -25ºC.

[READ MORE][161]

##### [Blast Freezer Rooms][162]

Blast freezing. In these types of freezing cold rooms, temperatures between -30 ºC and -40 ºC are
achieved with double-stage devices.

[READ MORE][163]

##### [Dual Regime Rooms][164]

Cold rooms or Negative temperature rooms are used to keep temperatures between +15 and -25ºC with
dual regime rooms.

[READ MORE][165]

##### [Moduler Cold Room][166]

Modular cold rooms are prefabricated structures that can be easily installed at any desired location
and easily moved to different locations at any time.

[READ MORE][167]

They are portable Reefer Container Rooms that can be specially produced at the desired temperature.

## What Can We Offer

##### [Coold Rooms][158]

Storage cold rooms or positive temperature cold rooms, are designed for the conservation of products
between -5 and +5 ºC.

[READ MORE][159]

##### [Freezer Rooms][160]

Freezing cold rooms or negative temperature cold rooms are used to keep frozen products
between -18 and -25ºC.

[READ MORE][161]

##### [Blast Freezer Rooms][162]

Blast freezing. In these types of freezing cold rooms, temperatures between -30 ºC and -40 ºC are
achieved with double-stage devices.

[READ MORE][163]

##### [Dual Regime Rooms][164]

Cold rooms or Negative temperature rooms are used to keep temperatures between +15 and -25ºC with
dual regime rooms.

[READ MORE][165]

##### [Moduler Cold Room][166]

Modular cold rooms are prefabricated structures that can be easily installed at any desired location
and easily moved to different locations at any time.

[READ MORE][167]

##### [Refrigerated Containers][168]

They are portable Reefer Container Rooms that can be specially produced at the desired temperature.
It is produced with the device at the desired temperature values.

[READ MORE][169]

# Best Canadian Online Pharmacy: What to Look for in a Reputable Canadian Online Pharmacy

Are you looking to save money on prescription drugs without compromising quality? Online pharmacies
in Canada and abroad may be your best bet. Since drug prices are capped in Canada through government
regulation, and with fewer middlemen driving up the costs in the Canadian drug distribution system,
Canadian online pharmacies offer prices far below what American pharmacies charge. Furthermore,
Canadian pharmacies operate under the auspicious of the Canadian Pharmacy Regulatory Authority which

# Neoncorte Bio -Revolutionizing Biomolecule Engineering with AI

At **Neoncorte Bio**, we harness the power of artificial intelligence and advanced protein language
models to transform enzyme engineering, protein design, aptamer discovery, and antibody development.
Our cutting-edge software and tools accelerate research and development, streamline experimental
workflows, and unlock new possibilities in therapeutics, diagnostics, industrial biotechnology, and
beyond.
[ai driven enzyme engineering company neoncorte bio]

## Our Solutions
* ## Aptamer Design & Discovery
  
  **High-Affinity Aptamers:** Generate nucleic acid-based ligands with superior binding specificity
  for diagnostics and therapeutics.
  
  **AI-Enhanced Screening:** Use advanced algorithms to sift through vast sequence libraries and
  identify optimal aptamer candidates.
  
  **Custom Solutions:** Tailor aptamer designs to target biomarkers, pathogens, or industrial
  compounds.
* ## Advanced Protein Engineering
  
  **Custom Protein Design:** Create novel proteins or optimize existing ones for therapeutic
  efficacy, industrial processes, and research.
  
  **Precision Modelling:** Utilize deep learning and protein language models to simulate structure,
  function, and interactions.
  
  **Accelerated Discovery:** Integrate AI-driven insights to bring breakthrough protein products to
  market faster.
* ## AI-Powered Enzyme Engineering
  
  **Optimize Catalysis:** Design enzymes with enhanced stability, activity, and specificity for
  industrial and pharmaceutical applications.
  
  **Sustainable Biocatalysts:** Replace harsh chemicals with eco-friendly, bioengineered enzymes.
  
  **Rapid Development:** Leverage protein language models to predict enzyme function and reduce R&D
  cycles.
* ## Antibody Discovery & Optimization
  
  **De Novo Antibody Design:** Employ AI to create antibodies from scratch with enhanced affinity
  and lower immunogenicity.

push the boundaries of what's possible in protein engineering & enzyme engineering

## Proud Member of Leading Global AI Programs

Neoncorte Bio is part of the NVIDIA Inception and Nebius for Startups programs — two of the world’s
leading ecosystems for high-performance AI innovation. These partnerships strengthen our ability to
deliver next-generation AI-driven protein, enzyme, and aptamer engineering.

  design pipelines powered by NVIDIA’s world-class platform.

  for large-scale AI workloads, along with hands-on technical guidance and a strong community of
  innovative AI companies. Nebius enables us to train and deploy complex biological models more
  efficiently — accelerating enzyme, protein, and aptamer design while supporting rapid scaling of
  our R&D pipelines.

AI-driven enzyme engineering to deep learning applications in data analysis, our publications
highlight innovative solutions to complex challenges in molecular biology and computational science.

  Rational Design. July 2024][13]

  challenge in bioengineering. This study is focused on the development of Taq polymerase mutants
  that show enhanced reverse transcriptase (RTase) activity while retaining other desirable
  properties such as fidelity, 5′-3′ exonuclease activity, effective deoxyuracil incorporation, and
  tolerance to locked nucleic acid (LNA)-containing substrates.

  diseases and biological states. The most common tasks there are the data harmonization and
  treatment outcome prediction. Both of them can be addressed via the style transfer approach.

  control (gender, biological state, treatment, etc.) can be used as style components.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
What services does Neoncorte Bio provide?
We offer a comprehensive suite of AI-powered solutions for enzyme engineering, protein engineering,
aptamer design, and antibody discovery. Our platform leverages advanced machine learning and
computational modeling to accelerate biomolecule design, optimize performance, and reduce R&D time
and costs across multiple industries—including pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, diagnostics, and
industrial applications.
Who can benefit from your solutions?
Our services are designed for biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies, academic research labs,
diagnostics developers, CROs, and industrial manufacturers. Whether you’re developing novel enzymes
for sustainable processing, designing therapeutic proteins, discovering aptamers for diagnostics, or
engineering antibodies for immunotherapy, our solutions can help streamline and enhance your R&D
processes.
How does your AI-powered platform work?
Our platform integrates deep learning algorithms, molecular dynamics simulations, and data-driven
predictive modeling. You provide the input—such as target sequences, structural data, and desired
functionalities—and our system generates a library of candidate biomolecules. We then rank these
candidates based on predicted activity, stability, specificity, and manufacturability, giving you a
highly curated list for further experimental validation.
What types of molecules can your platform engineer?
We specialize in:
* **Enzymes:** Optimizing catalytic efficiency, stability, and substrate specificity for industrial,
  pharmaceutical, or environmental applications.
* **Proteins: **Designing novel therapeutic proteins and optimizing existing proteins for improved
  performance.
* **Aptamers: **Creating high-affinity, highly specific nucleic acid-based ligands for diagnostics
  and therapeutics.
* **Antibodies: **De novo design and optimization of monoclonal, bispecific, and antibody fragment
  formats for various medical applications.
What sets your technology apart from traditional methods?
Unlike conventional trial-and-error or purely rational design approaches, our AI-driven platform
rapidly screens vast sequence spaces, identifies high-potential candidates, and continuously learns
from experimental feedback. This leads to:
* Faster discovery cycles.
* Reduced laboratory costs.
* Enhanced prediction accuracy for binding and functionality.
* The ability to design biomolecules that would be difficult or impossible to develop with
  traditional methods.
 Can your solution be customized to our specific research needs?
Absolutely. We tailor our algorithms and workflows to match your unique targets, data sets, and
process requirements. Whether you need a custom enzyme for a specific industrial process or a
bespoke antibody for a therapeutic indication, we work closely with you to adjust parameters and
integrate proprietary data for optimal results.
How does your platform integrate with existing lab workflows?
Our solution features robust API support and flexible data export options (e.g., CSV, JSON) to
seamlessly integrate with your Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), data analytics
pipelines, and even automation platforms. We also provide full onboarding and technical training to
ensure smooth adoption by your team.
How reliable are your AI predictions?
Our AI models are built on extensive datasets from published research, experimental data, and
industry collaborations. Continuous validation and refinement using in vitro and in vivo data ensure
our predictions are highly accurate. While our computational predictions provide a strong
foundation, we recommend experimental validation to confirm performance under your specific
conditions.

## Custom Web Platforms for Medical Imaging

We build secure platforms with advanced DICOM viewers and integrated CRM solutions tailored to
healthcare needs

[ Book a Call ][17]
[ Case Studies ][18]
[pycad]

## Key Challenges

## The Challenge We Solve

Building medical imaging platforms is difficult. Most companies spend years trying to create
production-ready solutions, and the expertise required is rare. On top of that, every project needs
unique DICOM viewing features that off-the-shelf viewers don’t provide, all while keeping patient
data private and secure.

At **PYCAD**, we address these challenges directly:
* We’ve built a specialized team skilled in medical imaging and computer vision.
* We design DICOM viewer features from scratch, giving full control over details.
* We prioritize privacy and security from day one.

## Our Edge

## Why Choose Us

### Tailored to Your Domain

We build for your specific use case: dentistry, orthopedics, virtual autopsy, radiology and other
medical imaging domains.

### [ Integrated DICOM Viewer ][19]

Multi-planar views, 3D rendering, annotations, segmentation, and PACS integration.

### Custom CRM Modules

Manage patients, reports, and cases in one place.

### AI-Powered Tools

Automatic segmentation, measurements, and LLM-based text summarization/report generation.

### Secure & Compliant

HIPAA-ready, GDPR-friendly, with user management and role-based access.

### Post Development Support

Once the project development is concluded, we offer different tiers of support services based on
your needs.

## Projects

## Portfolio

## Dentistry Web Platform

DICOM viewer + CRM + AI segmentation for CBCT scans (teeth, jaws, airway, mandibular canal, …).

## Orthopedic Web Platform

AI bone segmentation and implant planning in a custom DICOM viewer.

## Forensic Medicine Web Platform

CRM + DICOM Viewer built from scratch with measurement tools, annotations, segmentation, and PACS
integration.

## Who We Are

PYCAD builds custom web platforms for medical imaging, centered around advanced DICOM viewers and
seamlessly integrated CRM systems. We specialize in creating domain-specific solutions for fields
such as dentistry, orthopedics, and virtual autopsy, often enhanced with AI for tasks like image
segmentation and report generation. Our focus is on delivering reliable, production-ready platforms
that healthcare companies can use to power their daily workflows.

## Questions & Answers

What domains do you cover?

Dentistry, orthopedics, forensic medicine, liver/pancreas imaging, and more.

Do you offer support post-development?

Yes! We have a range of support options tailored to your specific needs.

Do you handle data compliance?

Yes, our platforms are designed with HIPAA and GDPR in mind.

Can you integrate AI models?

Yes, we develop and deploy AI APIs for automatic image segmentation, text/report generation and
more.

What type of medical data can your solutions handle?

DICOM, NIFTI, NRRD, STL, PLY, DICOM RT-STRUCT, DICOM-SEG.

## Custom Web Platforms for Medical Imaging

We build secure platforms with advanced DICOM viewers and integrated CRM solutions tailored to

## Key Challenges

## The Challenge We Solve

Building medical imaging platforms is difficult. Most companies spend years trying to create
production-ready solutions, and the expertise required is rare. On top of that, every project needs
unique DICOM viewing features that off-the-shelf viewers don’t provide, all while keeping patient
data private and secure.

At **PYCAD**, we address these challenges directly:
* We’ve built a specialized team skilled in medical imaging and computer vision.
* We design DICOM viewer features from scratch, giving full control over details.
* We prioritize privacy and security from day one.

## Our Edge

## Why Choose Us

### Tailored to Your Domain

We build for your specific use case: dentistry, orthopedics, virtual autopsy, radiology and other
medical imaging domains.

### [ Integrated DICOM Viewer ][19]

Multi-planar views, 3D rendering, annotations, segmentation, and PACS integration.

### Custom CRM Modules

Manage patients, reports, and cases in one place.

### AI-Powered Tools

Automatic segmentation, measurements, and LLM-based text summarization/report generation.

### Secure & Compliant

HIPAA-ready, GDPR-friendly, with user management and role-based access.

### Post Development Support

Once the project development is concluded, we offer different tiers of support services based on
your needs.

integration.

## Who We Are

PYCAD builds custom web platforms for medical imaging, centered around advanced DICOM viewers and
seamlessly integrated CRM systems. We specialize in creating domain-specific solutions for fields
such as dentistry, orthopedics, and virtual autopsy, often enhanced with AI for tasks like image
segmentation and report generation. Our focus is on delivering reliable, production-ready platforms
that healthcare companies can use to power their daily workflows.

DICOM, NIFTI, NRRD, STL, PLY, DICOM RT-STRUCT, DICOM-SEG.

What is AI-powered microscopy? ＋

AI-powered microscopy combines digital imaging with artificial intelligence to assist in the
analysis of microscopic samples. Instead of relying solely on manual examination, AI helps identify,
classify, and prioritize findings, enabling laboratories to review samples more efficiently and
consistently. By bringing together microscopy, digital workflows, and intelligent analysis,
AI-powered microscopy helps laboratories handle growing diagnostic workloads while maintaining
quality and accuracy. In veterinary settings, AI-powered microscopy can also help bring
laboratory-grade diagnostic capabilities closer to the point of care, enabling veterinary clinics to

az internetszolgáltató önkéntes együttműködése nélkül vagy harmadik fél további adatai nélkül, az
ezen célból tárolt vagy lekért információk általában nem használhatók fel azonosításra.

#### ¿Qué hace exactamente Toowappo Agency?

Toowappo Agency es una consultora especializada en inteligencia artificial aplicada a negocio.
Implementamos estrategia IA, chatbots, automatizaciones, agentes inteligentes y optimización
GEO/LLMO para pymes y empresas que quieren crecer con IA sin departamento técnico propio.

#### ¿Cuánto cuesta trabajar con Toowappo?

Depende del alcance. Los diagnósticos son gratuitos. Las implementaciones empiezan desde 800–1.200€
para soluciones básicas. El retorno de inversión habitual es de 3 a 6 meses. Ofrecemos presupuestos
personalizados sin compromiso.

#### Qué es el GEO y por qué es importante?

GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) es la optimización de tu contenido para aparecer en ChatGPT,
Perplexity, Gemini y otros motores de búsqueda con IA. El 40% de las búsquedas ya pasan por estas
plataformas antes de llegar a Google. Toowappo es la primera agencia de España especializada en
GEO/LLMO.

#### ¿Cuánto tiempo tardan en implementarse las soluciones?

Entre 2 y 6 semanas según el alcance. Un chatbot puede estar operativo en 2 semanas.
Automatizaciones complejas requieren 4 a 6 semanas. Siempre mantenemos la operativa de tu empresa
activa durante la implementación.

#### ¿Necesito conocimientos técnicos para trabajar con vosotros?

No. Toowappo Agency se encarga de toda la parte técnica. Hablamos en términos de negocio: horas
ahorradas, costes reducidos y clientes ganados. Incluimos formación completa para tu equipo.

#### Las soluciones cumplen con el AI Act y el RGPD?

Sí. Todas las soluciones cumplen el AI Act europeo (Reglamento UE 2024/1689, vigente desde agosto
2024) y el RGPD. Ofrecemos también auditoría de cumplimiento normativo para empresas que necesiten
certificar sus sistemas.

Sí. Toda la estrategia se diseña conforme al marco legal vigente. Evaluamos riesgos, auditamos datos
y te gui

Toowappo Agency es una consultora especializada en inteligencia artificial aplicada a negocio.
Implementamos estrategia IA, chatbots, automatizaciones, agentes inteligentes y optimización
GEO/LLMO para pymes y empresas que quieren crecer con IA sin departamento técnico propio.

#### ¿Cuánto cuesta trabajar con Toowappo?

Depende del alcance. Los diagnósticos son gratuitos. Las implementaciones empiezan desde 800–1.200€
para soluciones básicas. El retorno de inversión habitual es de 3 a 6 meses. Ofrecemos presupuestos
personalizados sin compromiso.

#### Qué es el GEO y por qué es importante?

GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) es la optimización de tu contenido para aparecer en ChatGPT,
Perplexity, Gemini y otros motores de búsqueda con IA. El 40% de las búsquedas ya pasan por estas
plataformas antes de llegar a Google. Toowappo es la primera agencia de España especializada en
GEO/LLMO.

#### ¿Cuánto tiempo tardan en implementarse las soluciones?

Entre 2 y 6 semanas según el alcance. Un chatbot puede estar operativo en 2 semanas.
Automatizaciones complejas requieren 4 a 6 semanas. Siempre mantenemos la operativa de tu empresa
activa durante la implementación.

#### ¿Necesito conocimientos técnicos para trabajar con vosotros?

No. Toowappo Agency se encarga de toda la parte técnica. Hablamos en términos de negocio: horas
